package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const StudentLearningWorkspaceSchemaVersion = "student-learning-workspace.v1"

var ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace = errors.New("invalid student learning workspace")

type LearningWorkspaceItemStatus string

const (
	LearningWorkspaceItemPlanned         LearningWorkspaceItemStatus = "PLANNED"
	LearningWorkspaceItemReady           LearningWorkspaceItemStatus = "READY"
	LearningWorkspaceItemInProgress      LearningWorkspaceItemStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	LearningWorkspaceItemCompleted       LearningWorkspaceItemStatus = "COMPLETED"
	LearningWorkspaceItemSkippedMastered LearningWorkspaceItemStatus = "SKIPPED_MASTERED"
)

type StudentLearningWorkspace struct {
	Schema         string                                `json:"schema"`
	ContextVersion int64                                 `json:"context_version"`
	SelectedPath   *StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath `json:"selected_path,omitempty"`
}

type StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath struct {
	LearningPathID string                         `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID       string                         `json:"course_id"`
	Status         string                         `json:"status"`
	PathVersion    int64                          `json:"path_version"`
	Items          []StudentLearningWorkspaceItem `json:"items"`
}

type StudentLearningWorkspaceItem struct {
	ReferenceType string                      `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string                      `json:"reference_id"`
	Position      int                         `json:"position"`
	Status        LearningWorkspaceItemStatus `json:"status"`
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(input StudentLearningWorkspace) (StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	if input.Schema != StudentLearningWorkspaceSchemaVersion || input.ContextVersion < 0 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}
	if input.SelectedPath == nil {
		return input, nil
	}
	if input.ContextVersion < 1 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}

	path := *input.SelectedPath
	if !canonicalWorkspaceUUID(path.LearningPathID) || !canonicalWorkspaceUUID(path.CourseID) ||
		path.Status != "ACTIVE" || path.PathVersion < 1 || len(path.Items) < 1 || len(path.Items) > 500 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}

	items := make([]StudentLearningWorkspaceItem, len(path.Items))
	identities := make(map[string]struct{}, len(path.Items))
	for index, item := range path.Items {
		if (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") ||
			!canonicalWorkspaceUUID(item.ReferenceID) || item.Position != index || !validWorkspaceItemStatus(item.Status) {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
		}
		identity := item.ReferenceType + ":" + item.ReferenceID
		if _, duplicate := identities[identity]; duplicate {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
		}
		identities[identity] = struct{}{}
		items[index] = item
	}
	path.Items = items
	input.SelectedPath = &path
	return input, nil
}

func StudentLearningWorkspaceDigest(input StudentLearningWorkspace) (string, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func validWorkspaceItemStatus(status LearningWorkspaceItemStatus) bool {
	return status == LearningWorkspaceItemPlanned || status == LearningWorkspaceItemReady ||
		status == LearningWorkspaceItemInProgress || status == LearningWorkspaceItemCompleted ||
		status == LearningWorkspaceItemSkippedMastered
}

func canonicalWorkspaceUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
